ko: 다윗처럼 다윗처럼 아무것에 구애 받지 않고
en: I'm free to do anything like David I'm going to sing with the freedom the Holy Spirit gives me

ko: 주로 인해 갖는 기쁨으로 감사 드릴거야
en: If I don't have anything like Habakkuk, I'll thank you for the pleasure of being mainly a human being
If I become the joy of God I serve,
I will not be ashamed, shout and praise him
